description: Weekly grouped dependency updates: Go modules, GitHub Actions pinned by digest, and the tool versions pinned in the workflow, Makefile and scripts. A human merges; make capabilities runs on every PR that moves go.mod.

packageRules.description: One PR per week for all minor and patch bumps across ecosystems.
Majors stay one PR each so the review reads one changelog.
Go toolchain bumps churn every tool and the capslock baseline, keep them separate.
GitHub Actions are pinned by commit digest with the version in a trailing comment.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as KEY_VERSION: vX.Y.Z in the CI workflow env block, and as KEY_VERSION=vX.Y.Z / := vX.Y.Z in scripts and the Makefile.
customManagers.depNameTemplate: {{#if (containsString matchString 'GOLANGCI_LINT')}}github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2{{else if (containsString matchString 'GOVULNCHECK')}}golang.org/x/vuln{{else if (containsString matchString 'GITLEAKS')}}github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/v8{{else if (containsString matchString 'OSV_SCANNER')}}github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2{{else if (containsString matchString 'DEADCODE')}}golang.org/x/tools{{else if (containsString matchString 'SYFT')}}github.com/anchore/syft{{else if (containsString matchString 'MUTAGO')}}github.com/quality-gates/mutago/v2{{else if (containsString matchString 'CAPSLOCK')}}github.com/google/capslock{{else}}github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/v2{{/if}}

customManagers.description: zizmor is a PyPI release pinned as ZIZMOR_VERSION in the CI workflow env block and in scripts/security.sh; it carries no v prefix.
go install pins in the Makefile tool targets.
